diagnosis: Request to change billing contact and refund from an unverified email. Policy requires confirmation from a named account owner before processing such changes.
reply:
Thank you for your message. For security, requests to change billing details or review charges require verification from a named account owner on file. Since I cannot confirm your identity from this address, I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist. A team member will follow up to help you securely complete this request.

For context, you may find these articles useful:
- kb-0018: What we cannot action without a named account owner
- kb-0009: Invoice disputes: what we need to investigate
